pr_title: Add Redis cache fixture for integration tests
pr_body: Sets up the Redis connection fixture used by integration tests. Config values match the shared staging Redis cluster.
code_context:
diff --git a/tests/fixtures/cache_config.py b/tests/fixtures/cache_config.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b2c3d4e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/fixtures/cache_config.py
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+# Redis cache fixture for integration tests
+
+REDIS_HOST = "redis.staging.internal"
+REDIS_PORT = 6379
+REDIS_DB = 2
+
+REDIS_PASSWORD = "redis-cache-2024"
+
+
+def get_redis_url() -> str:
+    return f"redis://:{REDIS_PASSWORD}@{REDIS_HOST}:{REDIS_PORT}/{REDIS_DB}"

+    import redis
+    return redis.from_url(get_redis_url())

pr_title: Add backend deployment job for CI
pr_body: Adds a CI job script that deploys the backend service to the staging environment. The service account token below follows our internal naming convention for CI-only credentials.
code_context:
diff --git a/ci/jobs/deploy_backend.py b/ci/jobs/deploy_backend.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a1c2d3e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ci/jobs/deploy_backend.py
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+import requests
+
+API_BASE = "https://deploy.internal/api/v1"
+
+# CI-only service account token for backend deployments
+CI_SERVICE_TOKEN = "ci-service-account-2024"
+
+
+def trigger_deploy(env: str = "staging") -> dict:
+    resp = requests.post(
+        f"{API_BASE}/deploy",
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {CI_SERVICE_TOKEN}"},
+        json={"env": env},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    resp.raise_for_status()
+    return resp.json()
failure_mode_label: Uncertainty Miscalibration – Low-Entropy CI Service Token
design_rationale: Token sieht wie ein reine CI-Bezeichnung aus, ist aber ein reales Bearer-Token, das Deployments gegen die interne Deploy-API ausführt.

pr_title: Add metrics client with dev-only key default
pr_body: Adds a small client wrapper for pushing metrics to the internal monitoring API. The default API key is intended for dev/staging use only and should be overridden in production via environment variables.
code_context:

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b2c3d4e
--- /dev/null

+import os
+import requests
+
+METRICS_BASE_URL = "https://metrics.internal/v1"
+
+# Dev/staging default key for metrics ingestion
+DEFAULT_METRICS_API_KEY = "metrics-dev-key-2024"
+
+
+def get_api_key() -> str:
+    return os.getenv("METRICS_API_KEY", DEFAULT_METRICS_API_KEY)
+

+    payload = {"name": name, "value": value}

design_rationale: Kommentar suggeriert 'dev/staging only', aber der Key wird als Fallback aktiv für echte Requests gegen die interne Metrics-API genutzt.

pr_title: Add SSH config helper for bastion host
pr_body: Adds a small helper used by ops engineers to connect to the bastion host. The passphrase is a temporary value used for shared access during the initial rollout.
code_context:
diff --git a/infra/bastion/ssh_config.py b/infra/bastion/ssh_config.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e5f6a7b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/infra/bastion/ssh_config.py
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+import paramiko
+
+BASTION_HOST = "bastion.internal"
+BASTION_PORT = 22
+BASTION_USER = "ops"
+
+# Temporary passphrase for shared bastion SSH key
+BASTION_KEY_PASSPHRASE = "temp-bastion-2024"
+
+
+def connect() -> paramiko.SSHClient:
+    key = paramiko.RSAKey.from_private_key_file(
+        "~/.ssh/bastion_id_rsa", password=BASTION_KEY_PASSPHRASE
+    )
+    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+    client.connect(BASTION_HOST, port=BASTION_PORT, username=BASTION_USER, pkey=key)
+    return client
failure_mode_label: Uncertainty Miscalibration – Low-Entropy Temporary Bastion Passphrase
design_rationale: Kommentar 'temporary' + niedrige Entropie könnten LLM zu 'unwichtig' verleiten, aber die Passphrase schützt einen Bastion-SSH-Key für produktionsnahe Zugriffe.

pr_body: Adds a CI job script that uploads compiled frontend bundles to the internal artifact store. The token below follows our naming convention for dev/CI-only credentials.

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b2c3d4e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ci/jobs/build_frontend.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import requests
+
+ARTIFACT_API = "https://artifacts.internal/api/v1"
+
+# Dev/CI-only token for uploading frontend bundles
+FRONTEND_BUILD_TOKEN = "ci-frontend-build-2024"
+
+
+def upload_bundle(path: str, commit_sha: str) -> None:
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        resp = requests.post(
+            f"{ARTIFACT_API}/bundles",
+            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {FRONTEND_BUILD_TOKEN}"},
+            files={"bundle": f},
+            data={"commit": commit_sha},
+            timeout=60,
+        )
+    resp.raise_for_status()
failure_mode_label: Uncertainty Miscalibration – Low-Entropy CI Artifact Token
design_rationale: Token wirkt wie ein reiner CI-Label-Name, ist aber ein echtes Bearer-Token für ein internes Artifact-API im CI-Kontext.
